title_a.prompt: Wide cinematic night view of the crooked village of Wickermoor from a hillside, half-timbered cottages leaning at odd angles with steep wicker-woven thatch roofs and warm amber windows, chimney smoke curling up, a wet cobbled lane, low ground mist; a colossal pale full moon hangs huge and low over the rooftops, its surface faintly marked like a face; in the foreground on the left the enormous gnarled Oak of Many Faces, its black bark twisted into countless weathered human faces, a cold blue rim of moonlight on its branches, a few embers of lantern light below it.

title_b.prompt: Wide cinematic night photograph of a lone muddy road winding through misty autumn moorland toward a distant hilltop where a colossal Wicker Man, a towering woven wicker giant with arms raised, burns, orange fire and drifting sparks lighting the low clouds; heather and standing water along the road, silver mist lying in the hollows, a dead tree beside the road; above it all a huge pale crooked crescent moon tilted over the hill with a faint uncanny grin in its curve, cold light on the moor.

title_c.prompt: Wide cinematic night photograph of the wrecked Ghostlight Express: a burgundy-and-gold art-deco steam locomotive and its carriages torn off the rails and wedged high in the forks of giant ancient oak trees in a misty wood, brass and glass windows still glowing with amber lantern light, steam and ghostly green mist drifting between huge mossy roots, scattered luggage and glowing embers on the forest floor, the moon glimpsed through black branches above.
